title: VP Duterte told: You only have yourself to blame for impeachment trial

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte has only herself to blame for the impeachment trial she is facing, House trial spokesperson Zia Alonto Adiong of Lanao del Sur said Sunday, arguing that the proceedings would not have taken place had she not committed any wrongdoing. Alonto Adiong reminded the public that the impeachment proceedings stemmed from allegations that Duterte misused confidential funds at the Office of the Vice President (OVP) and the Department of Education (DepEd); threatened the lives of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., first lady Liza Marcos and former Speaker Martin Romualdez; engaged in bribery; and failed to explain […]...
